items.text: Heads up, everyone! The Marston computer lab is waiving all printing charges until Friday at 5:00 PM. Honestly, I think this is a lifesaver before finals! Just show your student ID at the front desk. Go print those 20-page essays!

questions.explanation: The post says students simply show their student ID at the front desk of the Marston lab.

options.A: The writer rarely uses the computer lab.
options.B: The writer dislikes printing at home.
options.C: The writer works at the front desk.
options.D: The writer has a long paper due.

questions.explanation: The writer calls the offer a lifesaver before finals and urges others to print 20-page essays, suggesting a lengthy assignment of their own.

items.text: Hi Rosa, your statistics tutoring session is confirmed for Monday, April 7, at 4:30 PM in Kessler Hall, Room 12. The $8 materials fee is waived if you arrive before 4:15, so come early. Please bring last week's graded quiz. — Mr. Alvarez

questions.stem: According to the email, what should Rosa do to have the materials fee waived?

options.D: Submit the quiz a week early

questions.explanation: The email says the $8 fee is waived for students who arrive before 4:15, so Rosa should come early.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about arriving after 4:15?

options.A: The session will be moved to another room.
options.B: The tutor will cancel the appointment.

questions.explanation: Since the $8 fee is only waived for early arrival, coming later means Rosa would have to pay it.
